# Paneveil assets

[한국어](ASSETS-KO.md)

Every graphic, font, 3D model, sound effect and piece of music in Paneveil is
**generated by code in this repository at build time**. No images, fonts, recordings
or scores are taken from anywhere else, and no CC0 assets are used. All assets below
are original work under the same copyright and licence as the source:
**Apache-2.0** (Copyright 2026 devgyurak, the cleancart.nds maintainer).

The generator is `tools/mkassets.py`; the code that draws, synthesises and lays out
lives in `tools/cvtools/` (shared with the other games). The same source always produces the same bytes.

The PNG files in `docs/images/` (if any) are README screenshots captured from the
built ROM. They are documentation, not assets: the build never reads them and they
are not in the ROM.

| File (output) | Contents | Generator | Source / licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cv_font_tiles` | 5x7 pixel font (ASCII 0x20–0x5F), 4bpp | `cvtools/font.py` `GLYPHS` (glyphs drawn as strings) | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_ui_tiles`, `cv_ui_pal` | window frame and gauge tiles | `images.ui_tiles()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_smp_*`, `cv_sound_bank`, `cv_sample_names` | the samples the engine links (`SAMPLES_USED` in `cvtools/audio.py`) | `cvtools/audio.py` `make_samples()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_song_*`, `cv_song_names` | the songs, composed by code and shared with the other games; only `lantern` is played (the credits) | `cvtools/audio.py` `SONGS`, `compose()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_tex_paper` | 32x32 direct-colour paper texture (placeholder until the glass motifs land) | `images.textures()` `paper` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `cv_windows` | the window orders (target setting values) and par per window, packed by `tools/pvorder/pack.py` | `tools/window_check.py` reading `tools/orders/ch*.txt` (written by hand) | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `pv_field_*`, `pv_chapter_name` | setting and chapter names and value counts (text tables) | `tools/mkassets.py` from `tools/pvorder/model.py` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| `probe.bin` (NitroFS) | 2 KB known-CRC file the cart check reads | `tools/mkassets.py` | original, Apache-2.0 |
| banner icon (`icon.bmp`) | 32x32 4bpp icon, a six-petal rose window in a round frame | `tools/mkassets.py` `paneveil_icon()` | original, Apache-2.0 |
